scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const b = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'apps/game-server'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); const f = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'apps/web'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { b.kill(); f.kill(); process.exit(); });"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/game-server && npm run build --prefix apps/web
